events.text: A solar eclipse darkens the skies over much of Europe at midday.

pages.title: Solar eclipse
pages.extract: A solar eclipse occurs when the Moon passes between Earth and the Sun.

events.text: The first transatlantic radio broadcast of an orchestral concert takes place.

pages.title: Radio broadcasting
pages.extract: Radio broadcasting is the transmission of audio over radio waves.

events.text: A fleet of fishing vessels is lost in a sudden storm off the northern coast.

pages.title: Fishing vessel
pages.extract: A fishing vessel is a boat or ship used to catch fish in the sea.

events.text: The world's longest suspension bridge of its era opens to traffic.

pages.title: Suspension bridge
pages.extract: A suspension bridge is a type of bridge in which the deck is hung below suspension cables.

events.text: A famous chess grandmaster wins the world championship in a decisive final game.

pages.title: World Chess Championship
pages.extract: The World Chess Championship is played to determine the world champion in chess.

events.text: An expedition reaches the summit of a previously unclimbed Himalayan peak.

pages.title: Mountaineering
pages.extract: Mountaineering is the set of outdoor activities that involves ascending mountains.

events.text: A computer defeats a reigning national champion in a televised exhibition match.

pages.title: Computer chess
pages.description: Computer hardware and software capable of playing chess
pages.extract: Computer chess includes both hardware and software capable of playing chess.

events.text: A spacecraft transmits the first close-up images of a distant icy moon.

pages.title: Space probe
pages.extract: A space probe is an uncrewed spacecraft that travels through space to collect science data.

events.text: A massive digital archive of historical newspapers is made freely available online.

pages.title: Digital library
pages.extract: A digital library is an online database of digital objects such as text and images.
